desc:
Welcome to Cars 2: Worldwide Spies! With numerous maps to choose from and over 25 characters, including Lightning McQueen, Mater, Finn, Francesco and more, you can create your own high-stakes missions,  speed through numerous races, or just explore and cruise around as your favorite Cars characters! This game is constantly evolving, so check back frequently!

SEE TEAM CHROME GROUP AND SERVICES FOR PREVIEWS ON MEGA UPDATE AND MORE!

🚧 THIS GAME IS IN AN ALPHA STAGE! EXPECT BUGS, ODDITIES, AND INCOMPLETE CONTENT! 🚧

👍 Leaving a like is one of the easiest ways to support this game.

🚫 This game DOES NOT contain any assets that were created with GenAI.

THIS GAME IS NOT AFFILIATED WITH DISNEY/PIXAR AND DOES NOT GENERATE REAL REVENUE. SEE ALL DISCLAIMERS IN THE IN-GAME CREDITS.
